title: Bazaarvoice - Ratings, reviews, and UGC platform supporting product recommendations
clean_text: Bazaarvoice, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, is a shopper engagement platform specializing in collecting, moderating, and syndicating customer reviews, ratings, and user-generated content across a brand's own site and a network of retail partners including Walmart, Home Depot, and Costco. While not a dedicated recommendation engine, its review and sentiment data feeds into merchandising decisions and influences which products surface in recommendation widgets. Reaches over a billion shoppers monthly through its syndication network. Targets enterprise brands and retailers with large catalogs needing trust signals across multiple sales channels.

meta.target: enterprise brands and retailers with multi-channel presence
